title: cairn docs audience profile frontmatter
description: The frontmatter shape for one docs/internal/audiences/<profile>.md audience record (docs reset pass 2a, spec section 4). Property order here is also the order render-profile.ts renders in.

id.description: The profile's own id, the file's basename (evaluator, editor, site-operator, site-designer, admin-extender, or core-developer).

persona.description: One sentence naming who this reader is.

vocabulary.description: The vocabulary contract: terms this profile's pages may use, and terms they must avoid.

ceiling.description: The knowledge and tool ceiling, stated positively (what this reader knows and can run, not what they lack).

arrivalStates.description: The states a reader arrives in (for example, from a search result or mid-task).

success.description: The success criterion: what tells this reader, or an agent reading on their behalf, that the page did its job.

exemplars.description: Exemplar ids (<dir>/<slug>) into docs/internal/record/docs-exemplars.md, each naming a manifest entry and a capture under ~/.local/share/cairn/exemplars/<id>/.

provisional.description: True when this profile rests on no direct evidence yet and the audience review may still revise it.

provisionalReason.description: Required exactly when provisional is true: why this profile is provisional.
